post.description: Validates the references, checks that the texts fit the template, stores the certificate (`status: active`; `emailStatus` is `pending` with an e-mail address, `skipped` without) and publishes `certificate.issued`. Without `templateId` the latest template version for the organization, event and type is used. Errors: 422 `EVENT_ORG_MISMATCH`, `TEMPLATE_MISMATCH` (details name the fields), `TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND`, `TEXT_DOES_NOT_FIT` (details list every failing field); nothing is stored in these cases.

parameters.description: Optional retry key, scoped to the calling administrator and kept for 24 hours. Repeating a completed request with the same key returns the stored response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`; the same key with another body yields 422 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`; a concurrent duplicate yields 409 `REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS`.

post.description: Idempotent. An active certificate becomes `revoked` (reason and time stored) and its PDF is deleted. Repeating the call returns the current state with `200`; the original reason is kept and a different `reason` is ignored. If the PDF could not be deleted the response is still `200` with `warnings: ["PDF_DELETE_FAILED"]`; repeating the call retries the deletion. There is no un-revoke: re-issue instead.
